paras: Tropidonophis aenigmaticus, also known commonly as the East Papuan keelback, is a species of  snake in the subfamily Natricinae of the family Colubridae. The species is native to Papua New Guinea including Fergusson Island.
The preferred natural habitats of Tropidonophis aenigmaticus are freshwater wetlands, including near streams in forest, at altitudes from near sea level to 1,700 m (5,600 ft).
